stem: Which of the following was the most direct result of the environmental modifications listed above?

options.label: A
options.text: Federal regulations were adopted to ensure safety and ease of travel on the road.

options.label: B
options.text: State governments cooperated closely to maintain road quality.

options.label: C
options.text: Improved transportation to western states expanded trade and settlement.

options.label: D
options.text: Road construction became a major industry in the United States.

visual_elements: • Trees, stumps, brush, and rock were removed.
• Hills were leveled, and hollows were filled.
• Layers of stone were laid in graduated sizes.
